title: Affine Koszul Hom coefficient complex square

lean.statement:
theorem affine_koszul_hom_coefficient_complex_square
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens) (I : Ideal (Γ(Y, U.1)))
    (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (H : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} U.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) ℤ ⥤
      CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} U.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) ℤ)
    (hH : H =
      let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
      let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
      let E := (T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A n f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
      (homComplexFunctor (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj (op E)) :
    let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    let TC := T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let S := CochainComplex.singleFunctor U.1.toScheme.Modules 0
    ∃ (cO : H.obj (S.obj (T.obj (ModuleCat.of A A))) ≅
        TC.obj ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulDualComplex A n f).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
      (cQ : H.obj (S.obj (T.obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)))) ≅
        TC.obj ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulQuotientDualComplex A I n f).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)),
      H.map (S.map (T.map (ModuleCat.ofHom I.mkQ))) ≫ cQ.hom =
        cO.hom ≫ TC.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
          (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulCoefficientReduction A I n f)
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)

statement: Let Y be a scheme, U an affine open, A=Γ(Y,U), I any ideal of A, n a natural number and f:Fin n → A any sequence. Set T=tilde followed by chart transport, TC its termwise complex functor, E=TC of the integer extension of the Koszul chain complex, H=Hom(E,-), and S the coefficient single functor in degree zero. There are complex isomorphisms H(S(T(A))) ≅ TC of the extension of koszulDualComplex and H(S(T(A/I))) ≅ TC of the extension of koszulQuotientDualComplex. They intertwine H(S(T(A→A/I))) with TC of the extended koszulCoefficientReduction. No closed immersion, homology, or regularity is assumed. Schemes use [def-pc-scheme], T uses [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], and the chain and Hom complexes are [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex] and [def-pur-hom-complex]. The dual complexes and their coefficient morphism are the constructions of [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex] and [new-j3-koszul-quotient-coefficient-complex]. The functor H is provided as a parameter with equality hH to the specified Hom(E,-) functor; this is an identical functor, not an additional hypothesis on the geometry.
